geometry_notes: W1 is a straight line through a stepped facade: only s 0-13 is the 24 m tower face; the low wing (~9 m) and the service enclosure (~4.5 m) faces stand 3-5 m inside the line (lidar, sv_W1_YF4E).
The east and south-east arms of the tower top out at ~21-22.5 m (lidar), the north arm and NW at 24-25.5 m; walls.json gives 25 m for all.
W10/W11 are the bridge to E3 (open underneath from 0 to ~5 m), not a wing; the lidar strip at 9-10.5 m is the bridge roof.
There is a ~3.6 m gap between W3's end (1006.4, 240.0) and W4's start (1008.1, 236.8).

Cantilevers: ~3 m on W0 s 1-16 and W9 (whole length), ~2.5 m at the NW corner on W1 and at the SE corner; the lidar footprint is the upper-storey outline, so the ground-storey walls there stand 2.5-3 m inside.
W6/W7 ground is an open through-passage ~5.5 m high under the south wing leading to the south entrance; the footprint treats it as solid.
Courtyard terrace (~4.5 m) and loading dock below it sit between the tower, the low wing and the south wing; no wall in walls.json describes the terrace-facing faces except W3's upper part.
